Qns: Is Meta Trim BHB™ safe?

Qns: How do I take Meta Trim BHB™?

Just take 2 capsules with a glass of water daily with your meal.

Qns: What if I lose too much weight too fast?

This happens more often than you might think.

In those instances, we recommend taking Meta Trim BHB™ once a day instead of the regular 3 times a day.

And as always, consult with your doctor.

By 3 months, others will likely notice your change as well.
